pairs.locus: Holberg, Nicolai Klimii Iter Subterraneum, Caput VIII (the anatomy-chamber, terra Philosophica)
pairs.question: Qui dici possint boni viri, qui honesti et innocui hominis ventrem findere non dubitant?
pairs.answer: In honestos viros incidisti, qui malo animo nil facturi, solo anatomiae illustrandae studio hanc operationem decreverunt.
pairs.derivation: Klimius, told the physicians mean to dissect him, asks the matron a genuine interrogative. Dropped the interjected speech-tag/vocative framing 'inquam, Domina!' from within the utterance ('Qui, inquam, Domina! dici possint...' -> 'Qui dici possint...'); all remaining words are the author's, contiguous and in source order. The matron's reply opens with the poetic deflection 'Non venit in mentem, quorum consederis arvis:' which does not answer the 'how can they be good men?' question, so the answer start is advanced past it (and past its colon) to the operative answering sentence 'In honestos viros incidisti...'; window ends at the full stop after 'decreverunt' (what follows is narration, 'Palpitantem animum...' / 'Ad hoc regerebam...').
